name: lookup_default_value
description: Deterministic lookup of the versioned default emission factor for a sector/route/country, valid on today's declaration date. Never invents a number - calls calc_engine.lookup_emission_factor() against the cbam.emission.factor table. Raises if no factor is on file yet for this combination.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 exporting country code, e.g. FR, NO.
